description: Lu Bu, towering chinese warrior in the supplied pixel art style, riding a red-brown war horse. Two long red pheasant feathers rising from a gold crown, black and red armor with gold trim, a long red cape. Red-brown horse with red and gold tack. He holds a very long halberd with a spear point and twin crescent side blades in the right hand
face: Proud fierce young eyes, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the two long red feathers, black hair, the long red cape hanging over the horse's rump, the horse's tail between its hind legs.
guard_action: the rider brings the weapon from upright to a ready angle; the horse stands still on four legs

actions.idle: Mounted fighting guard, horse standing still on four legs, breathing
actions.move: Seamless gallop in place, rider carrying the weapon, no attack. The four legs follow the skeleton. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: Mounted DIAGONAL downward cut. Frames 3-6 the halberd is lifted and laid back over the right shoulder; frame 8 it comes down diagonally and its head lands in front of the horse while the hands stay close to the chest; frames 9-11 hold low.
actions.a2: Mounted UPWARD swing like a golf stroke, one hand, the grip on the pole never changes. Frames 2-6 the halberd is carried back and up behind on the right side of the horse; frame 7 it comes down beside the horse and its head scrapes the ground in front; frame 8 it swings up from the ground through the target; frames 9-11 it finishes high in front; frames 12-15 return to the ready pose.
actions.s3: Peerless overhead turn and ground strike. Frames 3-4 both hands come together at the middle of the pole and lift it above the head; frames 5-11 the halberd makes ONE full level turn above the head like a propeller: the head points back, then right, then FRONT at frame 8 (the first blow), then left, then back again; frame 12 it is driven down into the ground in front of the horse (the second blow); frame 13 holds; frames 14-15 return to the ready pose. The horse stands still.
actions.b2: Two mounted cuts, one on each side of the horse, one hand. Frames 2-5 the halberd is laid back over the right shoulder; frame 6 it cuts down on the RIGHT side of the horse; frames 7-9 it is carried up and over the neck of the horse and laid back over the left shoulder; frame 10 it cuts down on the LEFT side of the horse; frames 11-12 hold low; frames 13-15 return to the ready pose.
actions.pa1: Mounted DIAGONAL downward cut. Frames 3-6 the halberd is lifted and laid back over the right shoulder; frame 8 it comes down diagonally and its head lands in front of the horse while the hands stay close to the chest; frames 9-11 hold low.

actions.pb2: Two mounted cuts, one on each side of the horse, one hand. Frames 2-5 the halberd is laid back over the right shoulder; frame 6 it cuts down on the RIGHT side of the horse; frames 7-9 it is carried up and over the neck of the horse and laid back over the left shoulder; frame 10 it cuts down on the LEFT side of the horse; frames 11-12 hold low; frames 13-15 return to the ready pose.

Frames 3-4 both hands come together at the middle of the pole and lift it above the head; frames 5-11 the halberd makes ONE full level turn above the head like a propeller: the head points back, then right, then FRONT at frame 8 (the first blow), then left, then back again; frame 12 it is driven down into the ground in front of the horse (the second blow); frame 13 holds; frames 14-15 return to the ready pose. notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 원화의 무기가 본보다 훨씬 길어(약 170~200px) 캔버스에 안 들어간다. weapon_mode slide: 무기 끝은 본의 위치 그대로, 남는 길이는 손 뒤로 보낸다. 공격 중에는 손이 자루 가운데쯤을 잡고, 대기에서는 원화의 그립으로 돌아온다.
_art_note: 2026-11-20: 화극을 202px에서 175px로 줄였다. 정면과 후면은 shorten_lubu.py가 만든 사본(short-front.png, short-rear.png)을 쓴다. 측면은 아랫자루가 말 뒤에 가려져 있어 원화 그대로다.
